header: THE DEPARTMENT & DESIGNATION FINDER (People selection, facet "Department & designation"): I built it so the reader PICKS a department and/or a designation (and may type part of a name), so nothing has to be understood: the list is a FIXED SQL TEMPLATE filled with whole numbers (ids from the two pickers) and a name made only of letters. No language model is involved; the SQL goes through the same guard, the same read-only executor, the same log row and the same cards, masking and "Show more" paging as every answer the model writes. This file is pure (the SQL and its words); the run is in omnibar.ts (runRosterFinder).

members.name: name
doc: Part of a name that narrows the list; I allow only letters, spaces, dots, hyphens and apostrophes.

doc: Returns the sentence that says what was listed: the answer's own words, and I do not ask the model.

behaviours: a name narrows with the phonetic helper, one per word
nothing picked and nothing typed is refused with a sentence
ids come as numbers or digit strings only; anything else is refused
a name is letters only: quotes, semicolons and comments never reach the SQL
name words: at most 4, each 2 to 30 letters; Bengali and Hindi letters are kept
every plan passes the real SQL guard and has a stable total order for paging
the SQL selects the columns the people cards need
the sentence says what was listed
